title: Jamaican Roast Pork
description: A Caribbean-inspired dish with a sweet and spicy twist. Perfect for a dinner party.

ingredients.name: roast vegetables (such as carrots, potatoes, and onions)

instructions: Rub the pork shoulder with jerk seasoning, brown sugar, and soy sauce.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork to a large roasting pan and add the roast vegetables (if using).
Roast the pork in the preheated oven for 2-3 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Let the pork rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with roasted sweet potatoes and additional jerk seasoning (if desired).
